command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$root=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
$dir=Join-Path $root "logs\search-v3-indexed"
$before=Join-Path $dir "indexed-search-before.bmp"
$after=Join-Path $dir "indexed-search-after.bmp"
$code=@'
from PIL import Image,ImageChops
import sys
a=Image.open(sys.argv[1]).convert("RGB")
b=Image.open(sys.argv[2]).convert("RGB")
print("INDEXED_VISUAL_BEFORE_DIM",a.size)
print("INDEXED_VISUAL_AFTER_DIM",b.size)
print("INDEXED_VISUAL_SAME_GEOMETRY",a.size==b.size)
if a.size==b.size:
 d=ImageChops.difference(a,b)
 print("INDEXED_VISUAL_DIFF_BBOX",d.getbbox())
 print("INDEXED_VISUAL_DIFF_PIXELS",sum(1 for x in d.getdata() if x!=(0,0,0)))
'@
& python -c $code $before $after
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "visual metrics failed"}
Write-Host "INDEXED_VISUAL_METRICS=PASS"
